final grant audit injection changes target role and rolls grant, version and audit back
hash-valid bad body is refused before publication, while bounded multi-chunk originals preserve casing and bytes
partial original insertion and final action-record tampering roll the full business transaction back
member paging is scoped and material mutations reject injected professional data and stale CAS
schema is additive and safe-integer exhaustion rejects grants and actions without partial changes
